`preview-16.zip` is a frozen, image-omitted archive generated from Tasteprint
commit `77e92f35a0870c87b9c2ae466b201c5e8cddabb4` using temporary SQLite and a
synthetic Project. Revision 2 saves accent `#206493`, font family `serif` and body
size `16px`. It predates the DESIGN.md YAML frontmatter change.

SHA-256: `25efdfcca7469b33cd76c354e135f270eb9203a49216c4c55408a248278dbd45`.

The preservation regression verifies the original stored row/ZIP bytes remain
unchanged when a new template is generated for the same revision. Existing
`preview-9.zip` and `preview-10.zip` fixtures are retained unchanged.
